title: Az állami berendezkedés és a közteherviselés (State Organization & Civic Responsibilities)
grammar: Constitutional Regimes, Rights Guarantees & Legal Terminology in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name the three branches of power and the institutions that exercise them.
I can name two civic duties in the Fundamental Law: sharing public burdens and defending the homeland.
I can use kötelessége and felelősséggel tartozik.
I can read a short text about the state and civic duties and answer questions about it.
